description: This PHP class represents a Salary display field in the OrangeHRM reporting system. It extends ListableDisplayField and defines methods to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and fields related to salary information.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Represents a Salary display field in the report, specifying associated DTO, entity aliases, and fields for salary-related data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the DTO associated with Salary display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias(es) used in database queries related to Salary.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields that this display field encompasses, specifically referencing employee number.
